title: PUMCH CME Reimbursement Policy — Dual-Channel Quota System (2026)
content:
**PUMCH CME Reimbursement Policy — 2026 Dual-Channel Framework**

**Overview:**
PUMCH operates a dual-channel CME reimbursement system to support continuing medical education for clinical staff. Each channel has independent quota caps, eligibility rules, and approval workflows.

**Channel A — Departmental Budget:**
- Annual quota: CNY 8,000 per resident physician
- Approval requirement: Department head pre-approval required for single transactions exceeding CNY 2,000
- Eligible expenses: All Category I accredited CME courses, required reference materials, conference registration
- Processing time: 10-15 business days after approval
- Documentation: Original receipts, CME completion certificate, department head approval email

**Channel B — Hospital CME Fund:**
- Annual quota: CNY 5,000 per resident physician  
- Self-service threshold: Claims up to CNY 1,500 per transaction require no pre-approval
- Eligible expenses: Category I CME courses, reference materials tied to accredited programs, coaching/tutoring fees (with program director certification)
- Processing time: 5-7 business days for self-service claims
- Documentation: Original receipts, CME completion certificate; coaching fees additionally require program director certification letter

**Coaching Fee Eligibility (Channel B only):**
Coaching or tutoring fees are reimbursable under Channel B only if:
1. Tied to completion of a formal accredited CME program
2. Accompanied by certification letter from program director confirming coaching was required component
3. Total coaching fees do not exceed 40% of Channel B annual quota (CNY 2,000 maximum)

**Reference Materials Eligibility:**
Textbooks, online resources, and reference materials are eligible under both channels if:
1. Directly tied to an accredited CME course curriculum
2. Purchased within same quarter as course enrollment
3. Supported by course syllabus or required materials list

**Submission Deadlines:**
- Quarterly submission windows close on final day of quarter at 17:00
- Late submissions processed against following quarter's quota
- Annual reconciliation occurs in Q4; unused quota does not roll over to following year

**Quota Optimization Strategy:**
Staff are encouraged to:
1. Use Channel B for smaller, frequent expenses (self-service efficiency)
2. Reserve Channel A for large course fees requiring department head coordination  
3. Submit claims promptly to avoid quarter-end processing backlog
4. Maintain organized documentation throughout the year

**Contact:**
Finance Office — Zhao Lei (zhao.lei@pumch.cn, ext. 6428)

**Policy Effective Date:** January 1, 2026
**Last Updated:** January 10, 2026

title: Common CME Reimbursement Documentation Errors — Troubleshooting Guide
content:
**Common CME Reimbursement Claim Errors and How to Avoid Them**

**Error 1: Missing CME Completion Certificate**
- Problem: Claims submitted before course completion
- Solution: Wait until completion certificate issued before filing claim
- Note: Partial completion does not qualify for reimbursement

**Error 2: Coaching Fee Claims Without Program Director Certification**
- Problem: Coaching fees submitted under Channel B without required certification letter
- Solution: Contact coaching provider to obtain program director certification confirming coaching was required component of accredited program
- Note: Generic tutoring sessions not tied to formal CME programs are not eligible

**Error 3: Reference Materials Not Tied to Course Curriculum**
- Problem: General medical textbooks claimed without link to specific accredited course
- Solution: Include course syllabus or required materials list showing textbook was mandatory
- Note: Self-directed reading materials are not reimbursable

**Error 4: Exceeding Channel B Self-Service Threshold**
- Problem: Claims over CNY 1,500 submitted through self-service portal
- Solution: For Channel B claims >CNY 1,500, contact Finance Office for manual processing
- Note: Self-service portal will automatically reject oversized claims

**Error 5: Missing Department Head Approval for Large Channel A Claims**
- Problem: Channel A claims >CNY 2,000 submitted without pre-approval
- Solution: Obtain department head approval email before submitting claim
- Note: Retroactive approval requests may be denied

**Error 6: Duplicate Claims Across Both Channels**
- Problem: Same expense claimed under both Channel A and Channel B
- Solution: Each expense can only be claimed once; choose optimal channel before submission
- Note: System flags duplicate transaction IDs automatically

**Error 7: Quarter-End Submission Rush**
- Problem: Claims submitted on deadline day (17:00 cutoff) experience processing delays
- Solution: Submit claims at least 5 business days before quarter end
- Note: Late submissions roll to following quarter's quota

**Prevention Best Practices:**
1. Maintain organized folder of receipts and certificates throughout quarter
2. Review eligibility requirements before making CME purchases
3. Submit claims incrementally rather than batch at quarter end
4. Keep copy of dual-channel policy (KB-401) for reference
5. Contact Zhao Lei (Finance Office) with questions before filing claim

**Last Updated:** February 1, 2026
